summary: Moved HiCache storage prefetch progress checks out of the rank-locally bounded admission loop and ahead of local batch-full/capacity exits, so every TP rank checks the complete broadcast waiting queue in the same order before using a local result map.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: 4 failures because the queue-wide snapshot did not exist.
Five passing cases covering divergent local admission limits, unfinished prefetch, disabled storage, empty queue, and batch-full early return.
Ten focused scheduler and HiCache tests passed.
Patch whitespace and Python syntax validation.

gpu_execution.evidence: Hardware discovery found one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. TP=4 collective behavior cannot be executed on the assigned single GPU, so no GPU workload was presented as issue reproduction.

remaining_limitations: The original four-GPU NVIDIA TP=4 GLM-5.2-FP8 deployment, Mooncake/RDMA backend, model weights, and production traffic are unavailable.
The regression deterministically validates collective call-count ordering in the actual scheduler but does not reproduce the full production server deadlock.
The prepared environment lacks the ruff Python module; focused tests, git diff --check, and py_compile passed.
